subtitle: An urban Arabian Sea beach at a historic Kerala port city, patrolled by lifeguards and rated one of the state's most dangerous stretches of coast.
spike_statement: Kollam Beach, called one of Kerala's deadliest, got an IIT Madras geo-tube redesign plan in 2023 after 57 drownings in 7 years.

levers.photo_tone: Gray-green Arabian Sea swell against a working harbor skyline, the Tangasseri lighthouse pale in the haze
